notes.title: Dedicated Server Update Now Live
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dedicated Server Release Now Live[/b][/p][p]
Realmwalkers, our new Dedicated Servers are now live. To get started, download this update and create a new character or download one of your online characters to play. You can choose to play solo, join, or host a Friend.[/p][p]
Your online characters will continue to be hosted by Inflexion and will be available to download for up to a year. For more information about this update, please check out our last blog post [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1928980/view/557999619725853069"]here[/url].[/p][p]
[u][b]Release Highlights[/b][/u][/p][list][*][p][b]Dedicated Servers[/b] - Use our new Dedicated Servers to host or join a friend! We have also partnered with GPortal for paid hosting.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Start Menu[/b] - The start menu has been re-organized to make it easier to create a new character and then choose how you want to play[/p][/*][*][p][b]Online Character Download[/b] - You can now download your online characters to be used offline directly from the Start Menu. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Admin Panel[/b] - You can enable some of the debug tools and cheats our team finds helpful if you want to experiment with Nightingale. You can find more information about how to do this on our FAQs page here: [url="https://playnightingale.com/faqs"]https://playnightingale.com/faqs[/url][/p][/*][*][p][b]Monikers![/b] - You can now earn titles for your Realmwalkers that are displayed under your username.  Find the Moniker that represents who you are in Nightingale—from the classic [i]Realmwalker[/i] and the accomplished [i]Network Weaver [/i]to the whimsical[i] Chuckaboo [/i]and the chaotic[i] Rapscallion.[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Nightingale Dedicated Servers – Powered by GPORTAL[/b][/p][p]Our upcoming Dedicated Server release gives you the flexibility to play Nightingale how you want, whether you prefer to host your own Realm or play with friends.[/p][p]To make this possible, we’ve partnered with [b]GPORTAL[/b] to provide  easy-to-use servers around the globe. With GPORTAL, setting up and managing your own server is quick and seamless so you can focus on exploring, building, and surviving in the Fae wilds.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Additional Bug Fixes and Updates[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Item Rewards: Players now automatically receive the Cleansing Card when its requirements are met[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing & Store: Fishing mini-games have been adjusted and issues in the Porter Pistol shop purchase have been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Effects: The Ultimate Sickle weapon’s bleed damage has been reworked for clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Updated outfits and appearances of several NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Building swapping - In placement mode, added the ability to swap targeted structures with the new structure, with resources being refunded and/or dropped to ground. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]Social Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Parties: Parties are now based on who is on a server.[/p][/*][*][p]Players now see on-screen notifications when someone joins or leaves their party[/p][/*][*][p]Party Voting: A new Party Voting system lets group members vote on quick travel destinations.[/p][/*][*][p]Friend Join: Steam friends can now join your game when you host (via Steam relay)[/p][/*][*][p]Travel Invites: New safeguards automatically deny a travel invite if the host is still on the Continue Journey screen[/p][/*][*][p]Removed non-functional respite permissions

notes.title: Nightingale June Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Realmwalkers,[/h1][p]It’s been a few months since our Nightingale City update and we wanted to take a moment to step back and share where things stand, not just with Nightingale but with some of the broader work going on at Inflexion. More than anything, we want to share how we’re approaching the road ahead.[/p][p]A lot of our recent work has focused on long-term planning for Inflexion. That of course includes Nightingale, but also other projects we’re exploring as a studio. It’s not always the most visible kind of work, but it’s important, especially now given the realities of today’s games industry. Taking the time to plan well means we can keep developing the games we love.[/p][h3][b]Reflections on Nightingale[/b][/h3][p]Nightingale has been at the center of many of those conversations. We care deeply about this game. It’s ambitious and complex, and we’ve poured a lot into it. It hasn’t always been easy, but we believe in its potential and in the community that’s come with us this far.[/p][p]One of the biggest considerations has been our online architecture. From Nightingale’s earliest days, we aimed to create a shared-world experience that let groups of players join together to adventure in the Fae Wilds. The back-end architecture we created delivered that vision, with players connecting realms to other realms with magical portals. The team did a great job. But at the same time it meant constraints and limitations on our overall development speed and on gameplay elements that we’ve never resolved. Now with  more than a year of early access, it's clear that many players prefer to play solo or with a few close friends, further complicating what we do going forward.[/p][p]The other difficult truth is Nightingale’s review status on Steam. It’s nobody’s job but ours to make a game worthy of good reviews. But we’ve been sitting at “Mixed” for a while now, and that hurts because it reflects a gap between what we want the game to be and how it’s being received. Steam reviews matter because they shape how new players see the game and we know we have work to do if we’re going to improve them.[/p][h3][b]What We’re Doing Next[/b][/h3][p]To address the first challenge, we’re nearly ready to release our dedicated server. This has been in the works for a while, and it will allow you to host a dedicated server the way you do with many other survival games: privately, reliably, and on your own terms, while still enjoying diving realmdiving from realm to realm through portals you build or discover. We’ll have more to say about the specifics on that soon.[/p][p]As for the Steam review score and the broader player experience, that’s a bigger challenge. There’s no single feature or fix that will solve it. But we’re spending this summer focused on finding the right path forward, one grounded in what we’ve learned since Nightingale's launch.[/p][h3][b]Thank You[/b][/h3][p]If you’ve played Nightingale, left feedback, or even just kept an eye on what we’re doing, thank you. We’ll keep sharing more in the weeks ahead as we prepare for our next update, and we’ll continue doing the work to make Nightingale a game worth your time and support.[/p][p][/p][p]Take care,[/p][p]The Realmwalkers at Inflexion [/p][p]
[/p][previewyoutube="efpBPaROZGs;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Nightingale City Update
notes.notes:
Our latest update is now live and adventures in Nightingale City awaits.

[b]Defend Nightingale City[/b]

Humanity’s last stronghold is besieged. The Fae and their formidable Automaton Queen have unleashed chaos, and it falls to you to reclaim our home. Leap across rooftops, clear enemy-infested streets house by house, and explore the intricate network of sewers beneath the city.

Fight your way through three massive city quadrants, confront Bound invasions head-on, close the dangerous Transepts, and activate Pale Pylons to regain control. Your bravery and skill will be tested like never before when you face the fearsome Automaton Queen herself.

[b]Feature Highlights[/b]

Alongside the City, there have been improvements to our building system, as well as, new Gear and Fabled Charms!

[b]Enhanced Building & Customization[/b]

[list]
[*] Structure rotation and placement has been refined with more options
[*] Outfits, and Furniture: The update adds a Western-themed Frontier Tileset, Wrangler Outfit, and new furniture sets for the Crude and Tudor tilesets.
[*] Defensive structures can be obtained in the city. 
[*] New Furniture available
[/list]

[b]Powerful Gear & Fabled Charms[/b]

Tier 5 weapons and tools can be purchased with a new currency you can earn in Nightingale City. These weapons and tools have new components and recipes to allow for greater parametric crafting power.
[list]
[*] Tier 5 weapons and tools can now receive 2 charms
[*] Tier 5 weapons have unique visual treatment options both in crafting and in glamour	
[*] Tier 5 Fabled Charms can be purchased with the new currency.
[/list]

Fabled charms will make fantastic changes to the behaviours and powers associated with your weapons and tools. You can earn these as rewards in Nightingale City.

[b]Live Bug Fixes
[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue in online mode where the incorrect tier of dye was sometimes applied.
[*] Fixed Tudor Shelf to allow object placement on its shelves.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the Porter Pistol from appearing in the glamour station for customization.
[*] Fixed the Red Cross Knight's Cuirass Gear to include a customizable shell region.
[*] Fixed a quest issue where party members retained "Build transept" after passing through another player's transept to NGC.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Boss Rush quest completion when in a party.
[*] Boosted comfort values for beds.
[*] Fixed dye previews to ensure consistency with their final appearance.
[*] Fixed an issue where LB/RB were double-bound on crafting stations.
[*] Fixed an issue allowing players to use the map to travel to a loadstar.
[*] Fixed wood harvested from stumps initially appearing with a default texture before correcting itself.
[*] Fixed the party screen not updating immediately when a player joins.
[*] Fixed the issue where Immolation and Blast Miners Trap shared the same icons.
[*] Fixed missing health bars above fish.
[*] Adjusted aim-down-sights for the Mystic Slingbow to align with projectile trajectory.
[*] Ensured font styles now meet Steam Deck requirements.
[*] Added gamepad support for the Essence Trader shop screen.
[*] Improved gamepad navigation on the map.
[*] Fixed issues with the consumable radial menu when using a gamepad.
[*] Fixed an issue where changing Make Up color after using the 'Reset' button did not apply the change.
[*] Fixed an issue where resetting EYES>DETAILS did not reset SCALE and DETAIL sliders properly.
[*] Fixed defense encounters being startable while the Extraction Device was destroyed.

notes.title: Nightingale Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
[b]Nightingale Anniversary Update
[/b]Nightingale has officially reached its one-year milestone, and we’re here to celebrate with our next update. From a new dyes and customization system to tilesets and long-awaited bug fixes, this update brings plenty to help with your adventures in the Realms. 

[b]Dyes and Customization 
[/b]One of the most anticipated features is finally here: dyes and customization! As added functionality to the Glamour Station, you now have the ability to change the materials and colors of your clothing, gear, and weapons. As soon as you unlock this station, you can start customizing.

Here’s how it works:
[list][*]When you acquire an item with a specific characteristic that impacts its appearance, that characteristic is permanently unlocked at the Glamour Station.
[/*][*]For example, if you obtain an item with the Gold characteristic, you’ll be able to apply Gold to metals in the dye system from that point forward.
[/*][*]This system does not work retroactively, so you’ll need to obtain new items or pick up items you already have with desired characteristics to unlock their appearances.
[/*][*]For endgame players who’d rather not chase down every material, bundles of appearances are available at the Clothing Vendor in The Watch.[/*][/list][b]New Tilesets, Outfits, and Furniture
[/b]This update also expands building and fashion options with a new Western themed set:
[list][*]Frontier Tileset – A rugged new aesthetic for those seeking a bold frontier style.
[/*][*]Wrangler Outfit – A stylish new look fit for any adventurer.
[/*][*]New Furniture Sets – Enhance your homestead with additional pieces for the Crude and Tudor tilesets.[/*][/list][b]NPC Card Game 
[/b]Looking for a break from exploring the Realms while earning some Essence? Just speak to any of the NPC Survivors to play a match card mini-game where you can bet and win Essence.

[b]Bug Fixes and Quality-of-Life Improvements
[/b]Here are some of the most notable improvements from this update:
[list][*]Fireplaces now stay lit but only consume fuel when actively crafting.
[/*][*]Fixed flickering and blown-out VFX, providing a more visually stable experience.
[/*][*]Controller fixes: LT/RT are no longer double-bound to the Estate Cairn screen.
[/*][*]Improved Portal Meshes: No more squashed platforms when adjusting height.
[/*][*]Lancaster guns now deal proper secondary ability damage.
[/*][*]Essence Trader in Welkin’s Reach no longer gets stuck in an endless question loop.
[/*][*]No more spontaneous umbrella drops! Stay airborne as intended.
[/*][*]Quest NPCs now behave properly, without floating grenades or potions.
[/*][*]Correct climbing animations when injured.
[/*][*]Unique crust effects on tools and weapons now work correctly.
[/*][*]Smoother sprinting mechanics, even when moving toward the camera.
[/*][*]Missing quest markers fixed: The “Talk to Nicolas” marker now appears correctly.
[/*][*]Firearms no longer obscure vision when using Emotes.
[/*][*]Predator and Prey leather/hide tiers fixed.
[/*][*]Improved visual variety: Each tier of plant fiber now has a distinct appearance.
[/*][*]Harpy and Ishmael fibers now feature their proper creature appearances.
[/*][/list]

notes.title: Nightingale: Winter Holiday Update
notes.notes:
Our server maintenance has concluded and our servers are now back online.

Please update your game to ensure you can access Online Mode once again. The below items will not apply to the Offline Mode until you update the game.

It's recommended to restart Steam/Epic or verify your game files to make sure you're on the latest version. The game version shows in the main menu when you start the game.

Watch the Winter Update Overview video here: [url=https://youtu.be/gVUp3JPgnic]Winter Update Trailer[/url]

As winter’s frost settles across the Faewilds, the season brings numerous new features, improvements, and festive surprises to Nightingale. With today’s Winter Update, there’s plenty to explore. Read on for the highlights of this magical winter season.

[b]
Player-Hosted Servers[/b]

Player-hosted servers are now available, offering greater flexibility in how you experience the realms with friends. Two new options await when starting the game: Host a Friend and Connect to a Friend.

[b]Key Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Characters are now shared between offline mode, hosting a friend, and connecting to a friend.
[*] Download your online characters to play on friends’ hosted servers.
[/list]

[b]Host a Friend:[/b]

[list]
[*] Select "Host a Friend" and enter a port number for players to connect.

[*] Confirm settings, choose or create a character.

[*] Share your IP address and port with connecting players (find your IP via tools like icanhazip.com).

[*] If connecting outside your LAN, forward port 7777 (or your selected port) on TCP and UDP from your router to your PC.

[/list]
[b]Connect to a Friend:[/b]

[list]
[*] Select "Connect to a Friend" and enter their IP address and port.

[*] Join their hosted game and play as usual, with the host managing realm travel approvals.
[/list]

[b]Resource Automation[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/403b1c49bae6850e1c7149743a069058d5391b3b.jpg[/img]

Automate resource harvesting for your Estate using recruited Survivors! This feature will continue to evolve with future updates.

[b]How It Works:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Recruit an NPC as a Survivor.

[*] Assign them as a Resident of your Estate.

[*] Build a Resource Automation Station.

[*] Assign an Estate Resident to the station.
[/olist]

[b]Recruiting a Survivor:[/b]

[list]
[*] Interact with Survivors to obtain their Calling Cards.

[*] View Calling Cards in the "Calling Cards" tab of your inventory.
[/list]

[b]Estate Cairn Management:[/b]

[list]
[*] Access the Estate Management menu from the Estate Cairn.

[*] Assign up to 15 Survivors per Estate by upgrading your Cairn in the Progression menu (one Cairn per realm).
[/list]

[b]Automation Stations:[/b]

Choose from the following Resource Automation Stations in the Progression menu:

[list]
[*] Wood Station
[*] Mining Station
[*] Hunting Station
[*] Farming Station
[/list]

Assign a Resident to collect resources. Only Tier 1 resource stations are available in this update, with more to come.

[b]Winter Event[/b]

Celebrate the season with festive challenges and holiday-themed rewards! Check the Special Event tab in the Progression menu for unlock requirements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/1b0bcd6118a4617ebae383ebb10a44c765b06b23.jpg[/img]

[b]New Weapon:[/b]

Snowballs: Unlockable via the Progression tree and craftable at the simple workbench. Use the Charm of the Brawler to enable friendly fire for snowball fights.

[b]New Outfits & Decorations:[/b]

[list]
[*] Jolly Dress
[*] Winter Child’s Garb
[*] Magician Top Hat
[*] 16 festive estate decorations
[/list]

[b]New Food Recipes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Roasted Seeds
[*] Pumpkin Pie
[*] Spiced Latte
[/list]

[b]New Pet:[/b]

[list]
[*]Grimalkin
[/list]
[b]
New Snow-Themed Minor Cards:[/b]

[list]
[*] Cozy Winter Card: A peaceful snowy realm.
[*] Winter Wonderland: Increased gliding speed and height, with slippery ground.
[*] Naughty and Nice List: Creatures will drop coal and presents.
[/list]

[b]Improved Build Mode[/b]

Building has never been easier or more immersive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/11acb417c430583fa590f41e539fe8fc75d37f93.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Press “B” to enter Build Mode.
[*] Switch between Search Mode (advanced functionality) and Free Mode (immersive building).
[*] Customize crafting benches via the Station Traits tab to apply desired Augments.
[/list]
[b]
New Spells[/b]

Harness the power of the arcane with three new spells:

[list]
[*] Darkness: Create a shadowy orb that inflicts increased damage.
[*] Grasping Mire: Summon tentacles that slow and damage enemies.
[*] Life Drain: Absorb health from enemies to heal yourself.
[/list]

[b]Ring Course[/b]

Test your gliding skills with four new ring-gliding courses added to the Abeyance realm and Sylvan’s Cradle.

[b]New Tileset[/b]

A festive Obsidian Tileset is now available in The Watch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/d06499dcec161e953c6ea0f0c6fbd472e4aa66cf.jpg[/img]

[b]Additional Change Highlights[/b]

[list]
[*] Public Realm chat enabled.
[*] Fixed performance drop on Glamour Station.
[*] Resolved broken lighting on chandeliers.
[*] Charm of Brawling refresh issue fixed.
[*] Fixed hunger bar reset bug after eating food.
[*] Small violet flowers now count as “flower” resources and can be grown.
[*] Improved placement rules for ramps and planks.
[*] Fixed incorrect animation for bolt-action rifle aiming.
[*] Fabled Humbaba meat now spawns in Swamp Vault reward chests.
[*] The cold status effect is removed when players are sheltered.
[*] Resolved stuttering when wading in swamp water.
[*] Double-clicking clothing no longer unequips similar items.
[*] Players animate when using CapsLock for Auto Walk.
[*] NPCs retain health when changing areas.
[*] Improved collision resets for Sentinels and Sheliak in Boss Rush.
[/list]

[b]Known Issues[/b]

While the Winter Update brings many enhancements, some issues remain under investigation:
[list]
[*] Quests in the journal are shown as Nightingale cards.
[*] NPCs with blocked beds may get stuck wandering.
[*] Resolution change confirmation timer doesn’t work.
[*] On player-hosted servers, Eotens may float into the sky.
[*] Toggling the HUD hides boss health bars permanently.
[*] Inventories don't recognize controller focus until either Sort or transfer all are used (or mouse click/tap)
[/list]

notes.title: Nightingale winter update adds NPC automation and overhauls build mode
notes.notes:
After a tough launch for gorgeous fantasy survival game Nightingale, developer Inflexion Games seems to have really righted the ship. Despite studio layoffs, continued updates including the major Realms Rebuilt overhaul have brought new life to one of 2024's prettiest open-world games and restored player opinion along the way. As the year nears its close, Infexion CEO Aaryn Flynn and art director Neil Thompson reveal a final update for 2024, and there are a couple of very welcome improvements on the cards.

As the amber glow of autumn skies fade, the chilling breath of winter creeps through the Faewilds. Yet, before the icy grasp takes hold, the Realms promise one final offering of the season. 

Arriving today, Nightingale’s Autumn Update brings a number of new features for intrepid Realmwalkers to explore. 

To celebrate the update, Nightingale will also be 40% off on Steam! There's never been a better time to jump into the Realms. 

Check out the gameplay overview video below:

[previewyoutube=b-6CHTCjFPU;full][/previewyoutube]

This new update also draws to a close the Halloween Event. But no need to fear about missing out on any of the event items. They’ve been added to the Progression Tree. 

[h3]More Details:[/h3]

[h3]Boss Rush[/h3]
You’ll be able to find the new Boss Rush challenge in The Watch. Here, you’ll be able to fight an endless series of bosses, which will each have a random Minor Realm Card effect applied. Every boss you defeat increases the difficulty of the next. 

Your reward for facing this gauntlet are new Tier 5 and Tier 6 Infusions, as well as a whole swathe of new fabled resources. Do you have what it takes to survive?

[h3]New Weapons[/h3]

[b]Swords[/b]
[list]
[*] Swords are now available in Nightingale! You can progress through the entire game with a new sword for each tier.
[*] Primary attack is a three-part combo including two slashes and a thrust.
[*] Secondary skill is a parry/riposte, allowing the player to parry an attack, and then complete a very powerful riposte lunge attack.
[/list]

[b]Bow Magic Arrows[/b]
The Autumn Update introduces three new types of magic arrows for the bows!
[list]
[*] Entangle Arrows: Arrows that entangle enemy legs with brambles to slow their advance. (Careful there are diminishing returns!)
[*] Implosion Arrows: Arrows that carry a delayed detonation to your enemy.
[*] Slicing Arrows: A dual arrow volley connected by a magical garrote that slices enemies.
[/list]

[b]Launcher[/b]
[list]
[*] The last new weapon in the Autumn Update is a new alternative for the slingbow: the Launcher!
[*] The launcher is a multiple projectile weapon, capable of being loaded with many explosive marbles at once.
[*] This allows the player to quickly single fire with the primary fire, or use the secondary fire to crank up a large volley of marbles at once.
[/list]

[h3]FSR Frame Generation[/h3]
AMD's FSR3 Frame Generation has been added as a new option to increase framerate. This feature allows your graphics card to generate additional frames through interpolation, which should significantly improve framerate; however some users may notice some input latency and subtle visual artifacts. FSR Frame Generation should be available on most hardware, and and can also be used in conjunction with any of the upscalers (TSR, FSR, DLSS, or XeSS).
Because the underlying Frame Generation systems from AMD and Nvidia can't be enabled at the same time, users who have access to DLSS Frame Generation won't see the option to enable FSR Frame Generation. If you have an Nvidia 4000 series card and would like to try running with FSR Frame Generation, you can force DLSS Frame Generation to turn off by adding this in the Launch Options in Steam's settings for Nightingale: -slnoswapchainprovider.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42287033/44bbc3486fb0874af879154a92eb75b0c17f5cbe.png[/img]

Those are the big ticket items in today’s update. However, for information on smaller changes and updates, check out the other change highlights below:

[h3]Change Highlights[/h3]

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hitting 0 ‘Hunger’ will no longer kill you
[*] Hitting 25% ‘Hunger’ will still reduce your maximum health, and that effect will worsen the closer you get to 0
[*] Resting no longer removes your timed buffs, including food buffs
[*] ‘Exposed’ and ‘Grit’ traits have been removed
[*] Oberon’s Bounty works on damaged nodes
[*] Fishing stats affect fish catch rate
[*] Skinning a creature on uneven terrain no longer results in SFX spam
[*] Bound Mortar and Snipers no longer ignore ‘Stealth’ rating
[*] Sun Giant will finish his attacks when he sometimes would not previously
[/list]

[h3]Events and Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Halloween Event is over but the reward items have been added to the Progression Tree
[*] Plank and ramp structures have been added to the Progression Tree
[*] Puck should spawn more reliably during quests
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]Inventory and Crafting[/h3]
[list]
[*] Major Cards are sorted ahead of Minor Cards in the inventory
[*] Using more than 9 types of fuel at the same time will no longer disrupt the station fuel display
[*] Repair cost should be displayed correctly in the inventory when players have 0 essence
[*] Fix for ‘Back’ option on any crafting bench closes the bench menu, instead of returning to the previous tab
[*] Fix for logging out and then returning to the game when an item is in the crafting queue will cause the timer to display a negative number
[*] Fix for offhand item is not hidden when reloading the revolver
[*] Various fixes for materials on clothing not properly changing with crafting
[*] Structure and environmental fixes
[*] Upon placing any Bhutan pillar on Bhutan T-support Pillar, the one above will no longer levitate in the air and appear empty inside
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]AI and NPC Behavior[/h3]
[list]
[*] Recruited survivors may repeatedly jump over the stairs several times in a row, damaging themselves with every jump
[*] Survivors can no longer be hit by characters' knife attacks
[/list]

[h3]General known issues:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hanging augments functionality does not work on the right side of certain windows
[*] Speeding through dialogue results in text stuttering with single letter
[*] Hollowed Moor - Danu's interaction area is very limited and covers only her legs
[*] All Minor Cards remove ‘Gloom’ effect
[*] Deep Fae Wilds, Tavern, Forge, Greenhouse and Quarry Minor Cards not behaving as expected
[*] Oberon's Bounty is not giving bonus yield to some resources despite indicating it in the spell's description
[*] Applying enchantment to tool moves it to a different hotbar slot
[*] Fired arrows do not hit where player aims in 3P
[*] Special life bar of Azazel the Penitent might not be displayed after being downed and going back to them
[*] Remapping the interact key makes it so the prompt no longer displays a key
[*] Crafting station's traits slots may become empty upon player's return to the Realm
[*] Crude Portal might become unavailable when moving the blueprint near structures
[*] Stairs can't be placed upwards off floors
[*] Chests ended up in a bad persisted state when moving long distances
[*] Toggling the HUD on and off will permanently hide a boss health bar
[*] Climbing Picks have less range when in third-person camera mode
[/list]

[h3]Boss Rush Known Issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Puck will appear the first time you collect a Synchronous Lotus when he shouldn’t
[*] Pressing “Return to Crossways” on the map will get your character stuck, quit and reload into that character via the main menu to continue

notes.title: Nightingale focuses on the fantasy as huge Realms Rebuilt update lands
notes.notes:
The launch of Nightingale saw it reach a peak of almost 50,000 concurrent players; no small achievement for the debut release from developer Inflexion Games. Yet, despite its distinctive 'gaslamp fantasy' world, the new survival game struggled to maintain an audience in a busy year packed with the likes of Palworld, Enshrouded, Soulmask, and Once Human. Returning to the drawing board, the studio has been hard at work on the game's grand reintroduction - Nightingale: Realms Rebuilt. Ahead of its launch, I spoke with CEO Aaryn Flynn and head of production Leah Summers about the future of the game.

notes.notes:
With the Nightingale Realms Rebuilt update, developer Inflexion Games is giving its promising but flawed survival game the revamp it deserves. Despite a gorgeous fantasy world and a clever concept, it struggled to maintain a foothold in a year packed with contenders. Among its biggest issues are a lack of clear direction and meaningful upgrades, which are focus points of the new overhaul, but perhaps its Nightingale's most agonizing problem is its restrictive build limits. Now, Inflexion reveals just how it's giving players more freedom to create when Realms Rebuilt lands.

notes.title: Update Regarding Players Losing Respite Realms | March 11, 2024
notes.notes:
Realmwalkers, 

Over the last few days we’ve had a few reports of progression blockers we’d like to provide updates on.

[h3]Incident Recap[/h3]
[list]
[*] March 5th: We started getting reports that some players were falling through world maps, most of these reports were from The Watch.
[*] March 8th: We pushed a backend update to the servers that would detect if players were in this falling state when loading back in, and if they were deemed to be under the map, the game would force them back into their Respite Abeyance Realm. 
[*] March 9th: Approximately at 3:00 am MT we started getting reports that some players’ Realms seemed like they were being reset. Out of an abundance of caution, we removed the server change from the day before. After further investigation, it was deemed that the server change was not a direct cause of this issue, but as higher volumes of people were getting funneled back to their Respite, it meant more people were encountering the problem.  We attempted a server change and started Respite Realm rollback requests, but we later discovered the server change was not enough to solve the issue so additional hotfixes were investigated.
[*] March 10th: We pushed a game update so servers would do additional data checks before players enter a Realm. If there was a larger data discrepancy than expected, would abort loading and disconnect. If this happens, players should try to load in again. This prevented save data from being automatically overwritten in an incomplete state, but it meant that players were more likely to encounter Travel Errors. 
[/list]
[h3]Current Status[/h3]
[list]
[*] Since the emergency patch on March 10th, we have not seen any confirmed reports of players experiencing a Realm reset with valid save files after the update.
[*] We are continuing to track down the root issue so that we can fully address these cases that now result in a Travel Error.
[*] We have applied rollbacks to all those who asked for one up to 4:00pm MT on March 11.
[*] The issues of some players falling at The Watch are outstanding. We will be re-applying the March 8th server change as soon as possible as the new data checks are in place.
[*] Additional concerns or reports, such as, but not limited to, invisible walls and inconsistent build limits, are still a WIP as these are separate considerations.
[/list]
Please note that if you have not logged in since 4:00pm MT on March 10th, please check if your Realm was affected before the patch.

[strike]If you have logged in as of 6:00pm MT on March 11 and your Respite Realm has been reset or a rollback request failed, please submit (or re-submit) the following form: [url=https://forms.gle/RsDFmr2HkSH1MxWP8]https://forms.gle/RsDFmr2HkSH1MxWP8[/url]

Please include the following details in the notes:
[list]
[*] When was the last time your Respite Realm was in a good state (not reset)?
[*] Have you previously submitted a reset request?
[*] Did you have more than one Abeyance Realm?
[/list]
If you share a Respite Realm with others, only one submission from your group is needed.

Once you have placed a reset request, please do not log into the character until we share the next rollback wave has been completed on our social channels (listed [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1928980/discussions/1/7221029098491784414/]here[/url]).[/strike]

[i][March 20 Edit: Rollback requests are now closed.][/i]

We continue to investigate additional long-term fixes and additional updates. 

Thank you for your patience and apologize again to all those affected.

- The Nightingale Team (Inflexion Games)

notes.title: Playtest Update: Surveys
notes.notes:
Hey Realmwalkers,

Today we have an update about Closed Alpha playtesting. Over the next few days we'll be sending out a survey, which you’ll need to complete for a chance to participate. Everyone who has signed up for our newsletter on [url=https://www.playnightingale.com/]our website[/url] will receive an email containing the survey. Sign-ups will remain open throughout the testing period.

Closed Alpha is our first phase of testing. Participants will gain access to an early, in-development experience to test specific aspects of gameplay, rather than the entire game. Future tests will expand the gameplay and player numbers. 

Please read the details below for more information.

[b]How do I apply for tests?[/b]
We’ll be sending out a survey via email to those who signed up for the newsletter. You can still sign up on  [url=https://www.playnightingale.com/]our website[/url]. Keep an eye on your inbox and make sure our emails aren’t going to spam (you may want to add contact@playnightingale.com to your whitelist). 

[b]When will playtests take place?[/b]
We’re coming up to our first planned playtest. If you’re successfully chosen to participate we will send you date and timing details. 

[b]How many people will be selected to test?[/b]
We will be starting with a small number of people and expanding over time.

[b]How will you be selecting who gets into tests?[/b]
There will be several factors including but not limited to: when you signed up for the newsletter, your survey answers, your system specs, game genre preferences, and community involvement.

[b]Can I stream/take screenshots/make content about the playtest, or discuss it online?[/b]
Not at this time. As these tests do not represent the final Nightingale experience, there will be a strict NDA in place.

[b]What if I don’t get selected for these tests?[/b]
We’re planning more playtests leading up to launch, so please keep an eye out for future communications. You will not need to reapply for future tests.

Thanks for your support! <3
